newsitem.title: UK: Marsh & McLennan buys French insurer CECAR.
newsitem.headline: Marsh & McLennan buys French insurer CECAR.

text.p: U.S. insurer Marsh & McLennan Cos Inc said on Thursday that it had bought French insurance broker Compagnie Europeenne de Courtage d'Assurances et de Reassurances (CECAR).
Marsh & McLennan, which purchased a 41 percent interest in CECAR earlier this month, did not disclose any financial terms.

It said in a statement released in London that there were many synergies between CECAR's operations and those of its present operating company in France, Faugere & Jutheau SA, and it anticipates combining the two companies in the future.
CECAR is France's second largest insurance broker and expects to have gross revenues of around 750 million French francs in 1996. It employs 900 people in 13 countries.
